snippet.title: Give up the Ghost | RPG Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Become the Overseer. Explore the city. Solve the mystery. Change the world. 

Support us on KICKSTARTER!: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eitherorcollective/give-up-the-ghost?ref=3calio&token=0936391c
Join the Discord! https://discord.gg/M7Kw5FV2vr
Find us on Twitter! https://x.com/yonningap
Check out our blog! https://www.tumblr.com/eitherorcollective

----

GIVE UP THE GHOST is a dialogue-based roleplaying game set in a strange city at the center of the world. Assume the role of Overseer Alhart, a one-eyed wanderer tasked to investigate a grim and prophetic fire. You’ll explore the weird, haunted corridors of the city Forde, and in your search for answers -- you will come to know the heart of the city as well as your own.



#trailer #rpg #indiegame
